observations: White game console with a black center section and a horizontal slit in the side plates, characteristic of a PlayStation 5 Slim.
The console features a disc drive bulge on the lower right side when vertical.
One white and black wireless controller is shown in both photos.
The console is standing vertically on a light wood-grain surface.
A framed 'Love Yourz' J. Cole poster is visible in the background.
Both photos contain a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIODUN JAMES'.

claims.evidence: The photos show a console with the distinct design of the PS5 Slim (horizontal plate slits) in clean external condition.
One controller is clearly visible in both photos.
The exterior appears well-maintained, but internal wear cannot be assessed from photos.
There are no photos of the warranty seals which would prove the console has not been opened.
Requires testing the console under load for an extended period.
Requires testing the HDMI and USB ports with cables.
The seller uses the plural 'pads', but only one is shown in the photos.
The receipt is mentioned but not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The console may have internal faults or not power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and launching a game.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and played.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive

risks.risk: The console may have been opened or repaired despite claims.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the intact warranty seals.

risks.risk: The controller may suffer from stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used in a game or a controller test app.

risks.risk: The 'UK receipt' may be missing or for a different unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the receipt showing the serial number or matching date.
risks.if_unproven: as having no proof of origin

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and playing a disc-based game.
Photos of the warranty seals on the console.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Photo of the second controller if two are included as implied by 'pads'.
Video showing the console's ports and the controller charging.
response.reason: The item is clearly a PS5 Slim with a disc drive. While functional claims and the presence of a second controller are unverified, it can be priced at the worst case (single controller, unproven functionality) using the available PS5 Slim comparable.
